newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart and Mexico's Cifra say in talks.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart and Mexico's Cifra say in talks.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc and Cifra S.A. de C.V. confirmed Wednesday they are in discussions regarding the possible acquisition by Wal-Mart of a direct equity interest in Cifra.
Wal-Mart and Cifra said no definitive agreement has been reached and there can be no assurance that the discussions will result in any transaction.
Wal-Mart and Cifra said they do not intend to make any further public comment until a definitive agreement has been reached or discussions terminate.

Cifra, S.A. de C.V. (CIFRA) is a diversified retailing company founded in Mexico in 1958 and its shares are quoted on the Mexican Stock Exchange since 1977. It currently operates a total of 216 retail units and 157 restaurants. either alone or through a Joint Venture Agreement with Wal-Mart.
